entries.reason: ADR-0054 amendment 2026-08-16. Template PAYLOAD, emitted into customer projects, so a real defect this repo exports (see dossier 2.5 RETRACTION) - deliberately NOT allowlisted: an allowlist entry would grant zod to template-engine's OWN domain too, and would record as 'accepted' something that is merely unfixed. The port's callStructured(schema: ZodSchema<T>) writes an emitted out-port's contract in terms of a third-party type. Not burnable in this PR: the fix spans all 8 template files typed on zod, and is blocked upstream anyway by dossier 2.11 - template manifests have no npm-dependency mechanism, so nothing in the emitted package.json provides zod and the generated project cannot typecheck regardless. Stays baselined so it keeps failing loudly once that feature lands.
